name: Adolf Hermann Erland
original_name: アードルフ・ヘルマン・エルラント
source:
The present king of the kingdom of Erland. He is a hard-working man whose life was targeted by his relatives. He is a big fan of women, and hit it off with the main character due to their commonality.
